name: MEW Television Championship
epitaph: A title already active by March 2002, its own broadcasts announcing Morbid Wolf as the reigning champion before his first served defence, which he won.

name: MEW Women's Championship
epitaph: Held by Angel until a March 2002 broadcast, where Lost Warrior beat her for it with a falling neckbreaker.

name: MEW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Already active by March 2002, it changed hands twice inside three weeks: Baphomet took it from Mr. Satan, then lost it to Justin Tyme.

name: MEW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Already held by Sabbertooth by March 2002, who kept it against a challenge from Steve Anderson after the challenger was counted unable to answer the referee.

name: MEW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Sabbertooth and Night Hawk before Justin Tyme and Masked Man 2000, billed together as Flying Tyme, won it from them in March 2002.

name: MEW Suicidal Championship
epitaph: Defended by Jack against Nightmare in a street fight that spilled through a parking lot and a staff office before Nightmare won it with an office desk.
